text(await tools.exec_command({cmd:"cat > /tmp/exposed-alias-design-judge.md <<'EOF'
# Cross-judge verdict

Choose /tmp/exposed-alias-design-astra/design.md as the structural base, graft the indexed candidate-ID strategy from /tmp/exposed-alias-design-sol/design.md. This agrees with the parent's inclination, but follows independently from the current Entity already being search-specific and the actual merge retaining alternating MP/funder pairs on equal scores.

| Candidate path label | Domain invariants / churn | Exact semantics | GiST / pooled state | Maintainable diff | API / UI / verification |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| astra | 5 | 5 | 2 | 5 | 5 |
| sol | 4 | 5 | 5 | 4 | 5 |
| luna | 2 | 2 | 1 | 3 | 4 |

Astra wins the type design: Entity::Funder(FunderSearchMatch) preserves the existing service output and structurally excludes MP aliases without another universal wrapper. Private funder/source fields, compulsory alias text in the finite source enum, and unchanged Funder details identity are sufficient. Sol's private constructors also enforce pairing, but introduce an extra EntitySearchHit layer and service signature churn. Luna's broad MatchSource permits MemberName on ScoredFunder and alias on MPs unless constructor discipline is added; its three source variants encode an unnecessary distinction already owned by Entity.

Astra's exact query satisfies score/source/dedup semantics but deliberately does not make application search indexable, so it is insufficient alone. Adopt Sol's repository-owned transaction, SELECT set_config('pg_trgm.word_similarity_threshold', threshold_text, true), indexed canonical/alias candidate ID UNION using query <% column or column %> query, followed by Astra's exact score and best-alias lateral selection. Setting and query must use the same transaction; commit before returning, and rollback on error protects pooled state. Use the verified inclusive operator thresholds directly, with no epsilon or endpoint special cases. Query all aliases for selected identities before choosing provenance; apply exact >= request threshold and identity LIMIT only after scoring. Preserve original alias text, strict alias-score > canonical-score preference, deterministic C-collated alias ties, exact word_similarity ranking, and ID tie ordering.

Reject Luna's query <<% indexed_text: <<% is strict-word similarity, uses pg_trgm.strict_word_similarity_threshold, and changes matching semantics. Its word_similarity_threshold setting therefore does not control that predicate. Its claimed strict > endpoint exclusion and fixed cushion are contradicted by the supplied PostgreSQL 18 probe. Exact post-filter cannot recover candidates incorrectly excluded by a different similarity metric. Reject approximate KNN scores and raw-alias top-k.

Preserve the existing equal-score merge exactly: it emits one MP then one funder and advances both pointers, so it alternates equal-score runs; it does not emit every MP before every funder. Astra states this accurately, while Sol/Luna shorthand needs correction. Prefer Astra's ID tie order over Sol's additional name ordering to avoid an unrelated policy change.

Keep one source enum serialized directly into the API, required exhaustive frontend parsing including MP+alias rejection, canonical primary link and escaped secondary alias explanation. Verify fresh DB index definitions and actual operator candidate plan applicability, exhaustive-query equivalence at threshold 0/1/exact interior score, winning-source ties, original spelling, many aliases under per-identity limits, and local-GUC restoration after success/error. Run the project's real API/database/browser verification in addition to controlled-response Playwright checks; inspect the west mid result in the real browser, narrow layout, keyboard association and literal hostile text. Apply live index upgrades only after schema inspection and use the documented checksum procedure after schema verification.

Read-only judgment only; no repository modifications, installs, tests, database mutations, or extra agents performed.
EOF","max_output_tokens":1000}))

content.text:
Verdict saved to [/tmp/exposed-alias-design-judge.md](/tmp/exposed-alias-design-judge.md).

Choose **Astra’s type structure**, graft **Sol’s transaction-local threshold and indexed candidate-ID UNION**, then retain exact scoring, canonical tie preference and dedup-before-limit.

Reject Luna’s `<<%`: it uses strict-word similarity and a different GUC; the proposed margins cannot preserve search semantics.

One correction: current equal-score merge alternates MP/funder pairs, rather than placing all MPs first. Preserve that behavior.
